simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בָּרַר (H1305) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 18 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בָּרַר (bârar) means to clarify (i.e. brighten ), examine , select First listed occurrence: 1Chr 7 40.

definitions.usage: make bright, choice, chosen, cleanse (be clean), clearly, polished, (shew self) pure(-ify), purge (out).
definitions.full: H1305. barar [ בָּרַר ] verb purify, select (compare Assyrian barâru , be shining , in derivatives Zim BP 46. 73 Belser BAS ii. 154 ; Arabic pious, kind, true ; he was pious, good, virtuous, honest ) — Qal Perfect בָּרוֺתִי Ezek 20:38 ; Infinitive suffix לְבָרָם Eccl 3:18 , Ges § 67 R, 3; compare לָבוּר 9:1 (si vera lectio) as metaplastic form, but on text see בּוּר above; Participle passive masculine בָּרוּר Job 33:3-4 t.; feminine בְּרוּרָה Neh 5:18 ; Zeph 3:9 ; — 1 purge out, purify: הַמֹּרְדִים מִכֶּם וּבָרוֺתִי and I will purge out from among you the rebels Ezek 20:38 ; בְּרוּרָה שָׂפָה a purified lip Zeph 3:9 ; מִלֵּל֑וּ בָּרוּר utter in a pure, sincere manner Job 33:3 . 2 choose, select , only Participle and in Chronicler: chosen, valiant men 1Chr 7:40 ; porters 9:22 ; musicians 16:41 ; sheep Neh 5:18 . 3 cleanse, make shining, polish , passive participle בָּרוּר חֵץ polished arrow Isa 49:2 (compare De & Jer 51:11 below) 4 test, prove Eccl 3:18 הָאֱלֹהִים לְבָרָם that God may prove them (RV); — on 9:1 see בּוּר . Niph`al הִבָּרוּ Isa 52:11 ; Participle נָבָר 2Sam 22:27 (= Psa 18:27 ); — purify oneself: a. ceremonially, the bearers of the sacred vessels Isa 52:11 . b. morally 2Sam 22:27 = Psa 18:27 . Pi`el Infinitive לְבָרֵר Dan 11:35 purify (|| לַלְבֵּן לִצְרוֺף, ). Hiph`il 1. Infinitive לְהָבַר Jer 4:11 purify, cleanse. 2 Imperative הַחִצִּים הָבֵרוּ Jer 51:11 polish arrows (see 3 above). Hithpa`el 1. Imperfect יִתְבָּרֲרוּ Dan 12:10 purify oneself. 2 תִּתְבָּרַר Psa 18:27 = תִּתָּבָר 2Sam 22:27 shew oneself pure, just, kind.
